report.summary: Chunk 9 of 14: defines command_gate, pytest_gate, offload_runner, and TaskAttempt class with docstring claims about never applying result and structural guarantees.

handoff.purpose: Define gate factory functions and TaskAttempt class with docstring claims

symbols.name: command_gate
symbols.note: Returns a gate function that runs a command with timeout, captures output, and returns GateResult. Handles both in-container and direct execution. Claims that scratch directory removal never changes verdict.

symbols.name: pytest_gate
symbols.note: Calls command_gate with pytest_gate_argv. Claims to run repository's pytest gate through command_gate.

symbols.name: offload_runner
symbols.note: Returns a runner that uses daedalus.offload.offload. Claims repo_root is pinned to WORKTREE and that TaskAttempt refuses to construct without explicit runner.

symbols.name: TaskAttempt
symbols.note: Class to produce one candidate change. Docstring claims run() NEVER applies its result and that there is no code path writing the primary working tree.

claims.text: scratch directory that could not be removed appends to the gate's output instead of vanishing; it never changes the verdict
claims.why: The code stores scratch_error and appends it to output only after determining passed/not passed. The verdict (passed) is computed before scratch_error is considered, and scratch_error only modifies output, not passed.

claims.text: gate that exits 0 having produced NOTHING has not judged anything -- something ate the evidence. ... a green with no evidence must fail.
claims.why: The code after line 1002 checks if passed and not output.strip(), then sets passed=False and modifies output accordingly.

claims.text: Run the repository's pytest gate through :func:`command_gate`.
claims.why: The function calls command_gate, but we cannot verify that it runs the repository's pytest gate because the definition of pytest_gate_argv is not in this chunk.

claims.text: repo_root is pinned to the WORKTREE, so offload's snapshot / verify / rollback machinery operates entirely inside the isolated checkout.
claims.why: The code pops 'repo_root' from kwargs, but we cannot confirm that it is pinned to WORKTREE because the offload function is not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: Deliberately not the default: :class:`TaskAttempt` refuses to construct without an explicit runner, so no attempt can quietly reach a model because a caller forgot an argument.
claims.why: We see TaskAttempt's __init__ signature includes runner parameter without default, but the rest of the constructor is not in this chunk to confirm the refusal mechanism.

claims.text: run() NEVER applies its result. There is no code path in this class that writes the primary working tree -- see the module docstring for the three properties that make that structural rather than promised.
claims.why: The class definition is incomplete in this chunk; we cannot see the run() method or any other methods to verify this claim.

observations.what: The command_gate function contains a fallback for when log_path is not provided: it opens out_path directly and uses ManagedProcess without attestation.
The code ensures that if refusal is not None, it returns early with GateResult containing only basic fields (passed=False, returncode=None, output=refusal, containment=attestation).
The empty output check (no empty green) is implemented after scratch_error is computed but before it is appended, so scratch_error does not influence the passed flag.
